summary: Request to create sample code in each samples-sdk repository demonstrating the new standalone activities feature once it's completed in issue #706.
userImpact: Users will have reference implementations for implementing standalone activities across all supported SDK languages.
proposedFix: Create sample code in samples-go, samples-java, samples-typescript, samples-python, samples-dotnet, samples-ruby, and samples-php repositories.
keyQuote: Once the new non-workflow feature is completed, we should have samples in each samples-sdk repo to showcase this new feature.
